policy: This registry declares ownership, dependencies and allowed public read-side projections. It does not assert that any sensor, agent, chain service or certification is currently healthy.

nodes.label: SOURCE
nodes.authority: Canonical committed code and tagged revisions
nodes.evidence: Git SHA, protected PR/CI, registered docs

nodes.label: RELEASE
nodes.authority: Certified active runtime, artifact and rollback receipts
nodes.evidence: Exact release source, build ID and certification receipt

nodes.label: IDENTITY
nodes.owner: AoE2WAR app/API and verified Steam identity
nodes.authority: Authenticated player joins and account ownership

nodes.label: RATINGS
nodes.authority: Steam RM/DM ratings; app only projects them

nodes.label: REPLAY
nodes.authority: Recorded artifacts, game results and conflict vetoes
nodes.evidence: Immutable replay hashes and adjudication receipts

nodes.label: WOLO
nodes.authority: On-chain balances and reconciled settlement state
nodes.evidence: Chain confirmations, custody and settlement receipts

nodes.label: SATCHEL
nodes.authority: Owner-authorized wager holds and withdrawal journal, when independently certified
nodes.evidence: Pending independent financial release; no public operational certification

nodes.label: SPEED
nodes.authority: Build inventories and release-bound benchmark receipts
nodes.evidence: Cohort definitions, benchmark timestamps and exact build

nodes.label: TESTS
nodes.authority: Measured checks and weighted engineering readiness

nodes.label: AGENTS
nodes.authority: Sanitized system signals and inspection watchposts
nodes.evidence: Observed signals; not synthetic always-on AI processes

nodes.label: INDEX
nodes.authority: Per-route score lineage and verified specialty obligations
nodes.evidence: Current source/version alignment plus independent attestation

nodes.label: WORKSHOP
nodes.authority: Curated, explicitly published product and development chronology
nodes.evidence: Public Workshop entries, not inferred ChatGPT activity

nodes.label: RECOVERY
nodes.authority: Storage observations, backup and rollback evidence
nodes.evidence: Authenticated storage, activation and recovery receipts

nodes.label: BRAIN
nodes.evidence: Dated bridge observations, not LLM guesses
